raw_response:
This small plot is rented, only a quarter hectare, so I must be careful not to spend too much cash on it. I will put some manure from my cattle because that costs me nothing, and I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative like most of us do here in Tigray, but not a big amount since the land is not mine. I keep my own seed from last harvest — improved seed is expensive and for rented land I do not want to risk it. There is no irrigation here, we depend on the belg and meher rains, and my family will do most of the work ourselves.
